configurations.comment: Attach-only. This project lives under ~/Documents, which macOS TCC protects; the preview server cannot spawn a process there (getcwd/chdir return EPERM) until the app is granted Files and Folders access to Documents, or Full Disk Access, in System Settings > Privacy & Security. Until then run `npm run dev` yourself and this config attaches to it. Restore the spawning version below once the permission is granted.
configurations.name: dev
